questions.question: Which of the following applications is most likely to use UDP instead of TCP?
What is the main reason UDP does not guarantee ordered delivery of packets?

answers.a: It lacks sequence numbers and acknowledgment mechanisms
answers.b: It discards packets that arrive late
answers.d: It processes packets based on priority levels

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a typical use case for UDP?
Which of the following is a key advantage of UDP over TCP?

answers.b: Lower latency due to no retransmissions
